rows.quote: damaging both himself and a small area around the target
rows.reason_zh: 伤害数值调整后，一次施放仍能伤害目标周围的多个敌人。

rows.quote: Centaur cannot die from Double Edge.
rows.reason_zh: 双刃剑的自伤无法致死，这项限制没有提供抵御其他致命伤害的免死时段。

rows.quote: Causes Double Edge to slow enemy heroes
rows.reason_zh: 魔晶升级仍使双刃剑降低敌方英雄的移动速度。

rows.quote: Centaur strikes a mighty blow at melee range, damaging both himself and a small area around the target.
rows.reason_zh: 双刃剑仍以选定的近战目标为中心造成范围伤害。

rows.quote: Trampled enemies take damage based on Centaur Warrunner's strength. Each enemy can be trampled once.
rows.reason_zh: 每个敌人各自可被践踏一次，因此一次奔袭仍能伤害多个敌人。

rows.quote: Each enemy can be trampled once.
rows.reason_zh: 一次的限制针对每个敌人可被践踏的次数，施法没有消耗充能点数。

rows.quote: causing them to move through units at max speed
rows.reason_zh: 奔袭仍使友军以最高移动速度移动。

rows.quote: move through units at max speed
rows.reason_zh: 奔袭中的友军仍能穿过其他单位。

rows.quote: slow any enemy units they trample
rows.reason_zh: 被践踏的敌方单位仍会减速。

rows.quote: Throws a mysterious bolt of energy at the target unit.
rows.reason_zh: 投出的是能量弹，基础技能没有移动目标单位的效果。

rows.quote: Causes Chaos Bolt to create a Phantasm illusion to attack the target.
rows.reason_zh: 魔晶仍会生成攻击目标的幻象，归零的是幻象的伤害折减。

rows.quote: It stuns for a random duration and deals random damage.
rows.reason_zh: 基础技能仍会使目标眩晕，眩晕时长随机。

rows.quote: Throws a mysterious bolt of energy at the target unit.
rows.reason_zh: 混乱之箭仍直接选取单位作为投射目标。

rows.quote: attacks have a chance to deal a critical strike of varying strength with bonus lifesteal
rows.reason_zh: 说明确认了攻击触发效果，但材料未给出独立核实可破坏性所需的 IsBreakable 值。

rows.quote: attacks have a chance to deal a critical strike of varying strength
rows.reason_zh: 混沌骑士及其幻象的攻击仍有概率造成倍率不定的暴击。

rows.quote: with bonus lifesteal
rows.reason_zh: 新版保留了攻击吸血，删除的是关于攻击小兵时吸血折减的说明。

rows.quote: DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
rows.reason_zh: 基础技能仍对混沌骑士施加弱驱散。

rows.quote: Summons several phantasmal copies of the Chaos Knight from alternate dimensions. The phantasms are illusions
rows.reason_zh: 基础技能仍会制造多个混沌骑士自身的幻象。

rows.quote: When Phantasm is activated, also creates an illusion of allied heroes globally.
rows.reason_zh: A杖升级仍会在施放时额外制造友方英雄的幻象。

rows.quote: Chaos Knight is invulnerable for %invuln_duration% seconds when casting
rows.reason_zh: 混沌骑士在施放技能时仍会短暂无敌。

rows.quote: Chaos Knight is invulnerable for %invuln_duration% seconds when casting, allowing him to dodge stuns and damage.
rows.reason_zh: 说明将避开眩晕和伤害归因于施法时的无敌，没有写使在途弹道丢失目标。

rows.quote: Casting Holy Persuasion on Chen teleports all creeps under his control to him after a delay.
rows.reason_zh: 新增的群体效果是传送受控小兵，没有给神圣劝化加入范围伤害。

rows.quote: Chen takes control of an enemy or neutral creep and receives a percentage of its bounty.
rows.reason_zh: 陈在取得控制权时仍可获得该小兵的部分赏金。

rows.quote: movement_speed_bonus: [5,10,20,30]→null
rows.reason_zh: 神圣劝化已移除对受控小兵的移速加成。

rows.quote: Fully restores the creep's mana upon converting.
rows.reason_zh: 劝化时回满法力的是小兵，陈自身没有获得法力。

rows.quote: Chen takes control of an enemy or neutral creep
rows.reason_zh: 技能仍能夺取已有小兵的控制权，符合召唤物词条的定义。

rows.quote: Chen takes control of an enemy or neutral creep
rows.reason_zh: 陈仍能选择一只敌方小兵施放神圣劝化。

new_mechanisms.quote: Casting Holy Persuasion on Chen teleports all creeps under his control to him after a delay.
new_mechanisms.reason_zh: 基础技能新增对自己施放的用法，可在延迟后将所有受控小兵传送到陈身边。

rows.quote: Damages enemy unit, forces it to move slower and lets allies attack it more quickly.
rows.reason_zh: 调高后的伤害仍作用于一个敌方目标。

rows.quote: forces it to move slower
rows.reason_zh: 赎罪仍会降低目标的移动速度。

rows.quote: Damages enemy unit, forces it to move slower and lets allies attack it more quickly.
rows.reason_zh: 赎罪仍对选定的单个敌方单位生效。

rows.quote: Activating this ability will respawn his current Anointed Zealot.
rows.reason_zh: 狂热者的主动效果是复活当前的受膏狂热者，未加入对多个敌人造成伤害的效果。

rows.quote: teleport_delay: [6]→null
rows.reason_zh: 狂热者已移除传送受控单位的效果，该效果转到了神圣劝化。

rows.quote: giving it bonus base damage and the Martyrdom ability
rows.reason_zh: 新版仅给出 Martyrdom 的名称，删除了牺牲单位进行治疗的说明，无法确认治疗是否保留。

rows.quote: Activating this ability will respawn his current Anointed Zealot.
rows.reason_zh: 基础技能仍能使狂热者重生，新版明确由主动施放触发。

rows.quote: Activating this ability will respawn his current Anointed Zealot.
rows.reason_zh: 主动施放影响狂热者的复活，没有移动陈自身。

rows.quote: He begins the game with a melee lane creep as an Anointed Zealot.
rows.reason_zh: 陈开局仍获得一只受控的近战小兵作为狂热者。

new_mechanisms.quote: Passively provides bonus health, damage and move speed to non-hero units under Chen's control.
new_mechanisms.reason_zh: 狂热者现在被动提升陈所控制的非英雄单位的移动速度。

rows.quote: multiple piercing arrows in the target direction that hit all enemy units dealing a percentage of Clinkz' attack damage
rows.reason_zh: 一次引导射出的贯穿箭仍可伤害路径上的多个敌人。

rows.quote: dealing a percentage of Clinkz' attack damage and applying attack modifiers
rows.reason_zh: 技能箭可以触发现有攻击特效，技能本身没有给普通攻击附加新效果。

rows.quote: CHANNELED - Clinkz channels and shoots multiple piercing arrows
rows.reason_zh: 魔耗提高后，射击仍需克林克兹持续引导。

rows.quote: If the target is an enemy, Clinkz will gain the correct experience and gold.
rows.reason_zh: 吞噬敌人给予正常的经验和金钱，说明没有列出额外收益。

rows.quote: healing and gaining max health
rows.reason_zh: 吞噬目标仍会治疗克林克兹，新加的不叠加说明没有移除治疗。

rows.quote: Clinkz consumes the target enemy creep or friendly Skeleton Archer
rows.reason_zh: 死亡契约仍可选取一只敌方小兵作为目标。

rows.quote: does not reduce their armor
rows.reason_zh: 攻击可以穿透部分护甲，目标自身的护甲值保持不变。

rows.quote: Clinkz applies %hero_stacks%%% per attack, and skeletons apply %skeleton_stacks%%%.
rows.reason_zh: 克林克兹及其骷髅的普通攻击仍会给目标叠加穿甲减益。

rows.quote: Break disables the applying of new stacks.
rows.reason_zh: 新增说明明确破坏会阻止叠加新层数，但材料未给出核定该字段行所需的 IsBreakable 值。

rows.quote: Creeps and illusions deal 25% damage to them.
rows.reason_zh: 新版明确骷髅弓箭手受到小兵和幻象造成的伤害时只承受 25%，符合限定来源的比例减伤。

rows.quote: Clinkz moves invisibly through units until the moment he attacks or uses items.
rows.reason_zh: 骨隐步仍可使克林克兹隐身。

rows.quote: Clinkz moves invisibly through units
rows.reason_zh: 克林克兹在骨隐步期间仍可穿过其他单位。

rows.quote: Passive: Buckler Aura Grants %bonus_aoe_armor% armor to allied player units.
rows.reason_zh: 新增的范围效果给友方单位提供护甲，没有造成范围伤害。

rows.quote: grant nearby allied heroes and buildings a %block_chance_active%%% chance to block damage
rows.reason_zh: 主动效果仍能为范围内的友方英雄和建筑格挡攻击伤害。

rows.quote: bonus_health_regen: [12]→[9]
rows.reason_zh: 装备提供的生命恢复从 12 降至 9，仍为正值。

new_mechanisms.quote: Passive: Buckler Aura Grants %bonus_aoe_armor% armor to allied player units. Radius: %aura_radius%
new_mechanisms.reason_zh: 赤红甲新增玄冥盾牌光环，为持有者周围 1200 范围内的友方玩家单位提供 2 点护甲。

rows.quote: it shatters, Frostbiting enemies in a %frostbite_radius% AoE around its place
rows.reason_zh: 说明确认碎裂会对范围内的敌人施加 Frostbite，但未说明该效果是否造成伤害。

rows.quote: Frostbiting enemies in a %frostbite_radius% AoE around its place
rows.reason_zh: 材料没有列出 Frostbite 对移动、攻击和施法的限制，无法独立确认捆缚。

rows.quote: Frostbiting enemies in a %frostbite_radius% AoE around its place
rows.reason_zh: 说明只给出 Frostbite 的名称，没有写明受影响的敌人无法普通攻击。

rows.quote: disjointing incoming projectiles
rows.reason_zh: 施放技能仍能使已飞来的弹道丢失目标。

rows.quote: Slides in a direction, creating a crystal clone of herself in her place
rows.reason_zh: 原行所列魔晶条件下，水晶室女仍会向指定方向滑行并将克隆体留在原处。

rows.quote: Slides in a direction
rows.reason_zh: 滑行说明没有交代能否穿过树木及悬崖等不可通行地形。

rows.quote: Surrounds Crystal Maiden with %num_explosions% random icy explosions that slow enemies and deal massive damage.
rows.reason_zh: 一次施放产生的多次冰爆仍可伤害周围多个敌人。

rows.quote: The slow is applied on all enemies in the radius, even if they aren't hit by an explosion
rows.reason_zh: 技能持续期间，水晶室女周围范围内的所有敌人都会受到减速。

rows.quote: Applies Frostbite to any unit that has been standing in the Freezing Field for over %frostbite_delay%s.
rows.reason_zh: A杖仍会对停留足够久的单位施加 Frostbite，但材料未列出确认捆缚所需的行动限制。

rows.quote: Can still be interrupted by enemies.
rows.reason_zh: 这句说明敌人能打断水晶室女的极寒领域，没有赋予极寒领域打断敌方引导的效果。

rows.quote: CHANNELED - Surrounds Crystal Maiden with %num_explosions% random icy explosions
rows.reason_zh: 基础技能仍明确标为持续施法。

rows.quote: Applies Frostbite to any unit that has been standing in the Freezing Field for over %frostbite_delay%s.
rows.reason_zh: A杖说明写明会施加 Frostbite，但未说明目标是否无法普通攻击。

rows.quote: The slow is applied on all enemies in the radius
rows.reason_zh: 基础技能仍会降低半径内所有敌人的移动速度。
给出的变化属于 behavior 字段，缺少判定可破坏性所需的 IsBreakable 值。

rows.quote: When Dark Seer levels up, he restores a percentage of his max health and mana.
rows.reason_zh: 黑暗贤者升级时仍会按自身最大生命值的比例回血。

rows.quote: When Dark Seer levels up, he restores a percentage of his max health and mana.
rows.reason_zh: 黑暗贤者升级时仍会按自身最大法力值的比例回蓝。

rows.quote: damages enemy units in an area around it
rows.reason_zh: 一个离子外壳仍能伤害携带者周围的多个敌方单位。

rows.quote: Surrounds the target unit with a bristling shield that damages enemy units in an area around it.
rows.reason_zh: 伤害区域以携带外壳的单位为中心，持续影响其周围的敌人。

rows.quote: Surrounds the target unit with a bristling shield
rows.reason_zh: 技能仍以选定的单位为施放目标，材料未显示原行所记的敌方目标资格发生变化。

rows.quote: Causes Dark Seer's next attack on a hero to have True Strike, knock a replica out of the victim, damaging and stunning them
rows.reason_zh: 原行所列A杖条件下，对英雄的下一次攻击仍附带伤害和眩晕。

rows.quote: knock a replica out of the victim, damaging and stunning them
rows.reason_zh: 原行所列A杖条件下，强化攻击仍会击晕受击英雄，符合攻击触发重击的定义。

rows.quote: Passive ability.
rows.reason_zh: 被动技能这一描述无法确定其可破坏性，材料也未给出 IsBreakable 值。

rows.quote: knock a replica out of the victim
rows.reason_zh: 普通一拳仍会制造受击英雄的复制体。

rows.quote: Causes Dark Seer's next attack on a hero to have True Strike
rows.reason_zh: 对英雄的下一次强化攻击仍具备必中效果。

rows.quote: damaging and stunning them based on how far Dark Seer has moved
rows.reason_zh: 命中英雄时仍会造成眩晕，效果取决于黑暗贤者此前移动的距离。

rows.quote: a vacuum over the target area that sucks in enemy units, disrupting them and dealing damage
rows.reason_zh: 冷却缩短后，一次真空仍能伤害目标区域内的多个敌人。

rows.quote: This ability interrupts channeling.
rows.reason_zh: 技能说明明确保留了打断持续施法的效果。

rows.quote: Pulls units over %duration% seconds before dealing damage.
rows.reason_zh: 真空仍会在造成伤害前牵引敌方单位。

rows.quote: Trees near the center of the vacuum will be destroyed.
rows.reason_zh: 真空中心附近的树木仍会被摧毁。

rows.quote: slows, damages, and creates replicas of any enemy hero who crosses it
rows.reason_zh: 同一面墙仍能对穿过它的多个敌方英雄分别造成伤害。

rows.quote: Raises a wall of warping light that slows, damages, and creates replicas of any enemy hero who crosses it.
rows.reason_zh: 施放后，光墙在持续期间留在原处，对经过该位置的敌方英雄生效。

rows.quote: There cannot be more than one illusion per player per wall.
rows.reason_zh: 光墙仍会制造幻象，每面墙对每名玩家最多保有一个幻象。

rows.quote: slows, damages, and creates replicas of any enemy hero who crosses it
rows.reason_zh: 穿过光墙的敌方英雄仍会减速。
